text:
maria: Heads-up — starting onboarding for customer Scallion's LoRA overlay on vesta-7b. Dropping a quick eval pack. Need tokenizer sanity check + int4 quant smoke. Who can run the first pass?

Derek: I can run on ded-gpu-03. Are we applying as an overlay or merging upstream?

maria: Overlay for now. Their adapter remaps a few currency tokens (euro, pound) — token ids differ from our tokenizer. Sample mapping below. Also want invoice extraction checks in the pack.

sophie: paste the mapping, i'll make a remap script.

maria: mapping snippet: {"€": 5023, "£": 5981, "$": 23} — we'll map to our ids in currency_map.json and run tokenizer remap before eval.

Derek: kicking off smoke: `./run_eval.sh --model vesta-7b+scallion-lora --quant int4 --batch 8 --prompts eval_pack.json` — queued on ded-gpu-03.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: job 4621 queued on ded-gpu-03 (pool: dedicated, tag: smoke)

eval-bot: eval-bot: initial quick-eval results (job 4621): fluency pass, invoice_amount extraction: 0.82 (baseline 0.95). Example failure: `Total: €1,200` -> output `1200` (currency lost).

maria: sounds like tokenizer remap issue. @sophie please run `remap_tokens.py --map=currency_map.json --inplace` and add kv cache pad of 8 — we've seen small offsets with int4 kernels.

sophie: remap applied; updated pack and re-running. Added negative/parentheses cases to the eval set (e.g., `(1,200)` and `-1,200`).

Derek: re-run (job 4627) with kv_pad=8 and tokenizer_override: `./run_eval.sh --model vesta-7b+scallion-lora --quant int4 --kv_pad 8 --tokenizer_override currency_map.json`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: job 4627 started on ded-gpu-03

eval-bot: eval-bot: run 4627 results: invoice_amount extraction 0.96, latency +2ms median, token usage +0.5% on avg. Regression fixed; edge-case coverage improved.

maria: great. Recommendation: bundle tokenizer-remap into adapter install, canary rollout at 5% traffic, monitor invoice accuracy & latency for 24h, rollback if accuracy < 0.95. I'll open rollout ticket.

sophie: will add migration note and include currency_map.json in the adapter README + install hook, and add parenthesis/negative tests to smoke pack.

Derek: i'll schedule the canary and add per-route traces to Console so we can correlate any latency blips.

maria: thanks team :thumbsup: — attaching eval artifacts and opening INF-7823 with rollout plan. Good job :party_parrot:
